newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ROWELL DELAYS NAMING SUCCESSOR TO CARLING.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ROWELL DELAYS NAMING SUCCESSOR TO CARLING.

text.p: England manager Jack Rowell has delayed announcing a successor to Will Carling as England captain until the current row between the Rugby Football Union (RFU) and the leading English clubs is resolved.

"A captain has been agreed upon but we are not naming him because I don't want him caught in the crossfire of the politics that are ongoing," Rowell said on Wednesday after the England squad's first training session.
Carling resigned as England captain in March but is still available for international rugby.

The England squad boycotted an earlier training session this month, opting instead to attend a meeting of the English Professional Rugby Union Clubs who have threatened to split from the RFU if they are not given more power and more money.
"My understanding is that the issues will dissolve soon and we can publicly appoint a leader," Rowell said. "If there had not been a conflict, I would have named the captain before today."
